caption:
Buy now, pay later is everywhere this holiday season. 🛍️

Per Federal Reserve data cited by 24/7 Wall St., slightly more than a quarter of BNPL users paid late.
11% said a payment triggered an overdraft or insufficient-funds fee.

Before you split a payment, check when each installment hits your account.

Do you use BNPL?
